enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on the bed. Pulls the blanket over the body. Closes eyes. Keeps the fan running. Remains still in bed. Turns to the other side. Remains asleep until the alarm sounds at 06:30.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting dressed
enriched_activities.desc: Turns off the alarm on the phone. Sits up on the edge of the bed. Stands up. Walks to the bathroom. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the tap. Cups water in hands. Splashes water on the face. Turns off the tap. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth with water. Spits into the sink. Turns off the tap. Picks up the towel. Wipes the face. Hangs the towel back. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out of the bathroom. Walks to Bedroom 1. Opens the wardrobe. Takes out a shirt and trousers. Puts on the shirt. Puts on the trousers. Puts on socks. Walks back to the bathroom.

Walks into the kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out eggs, milk and bread. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Picks up the frying pan. Places the frying pan on the induction cooker. Presses the power button on the induction cooker. Pours oil into the pan. Cracks the eggs into the pan. Picks up the spatula. Stirs the eggs. Turns off the induction cooker. Picks up the plate. Slides the eggs onto the plate. Picks up the bread. Puts the bread into the toaster. Presses the toaster lever down. Picks up the kettle. Fills the kettle with water. Places the kettle on the base. Presses the kettle switch. Waits for the toast. Takes the toast out of the toaster. Places the toast on the plate. Sits down at the table. Picks up the fork. Eats the eggs and toast. Drinks the milk from the glass.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the breakfast dishes and brewing a cup of tea
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the table. Picks up the plate, fork and glass. Carries them to the sink. Opens the dishwasher door. Places the plate, fork and glass into the dishwasher. Closes the dishwasher door. Presses the start button on the dishwasher. Wipes the table with a cloth. Rinses the cloth under the tap. Turns off the tap. Picks up a tea bag. Places the tea bag into a mug. Pours hot water from the kettle into the mug. Picks up the mug. Carries the mug toward the living room. Turns off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the home workspace, checking email and reviewing the day's community program schedule (no commute because of the public transport strike)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into the living room. Places the mug on the desk. Picks up the computer. Opens the laptop lid. Presses the power button. Waits for the screen to load. Turns on the desk lamp. Opens the email application. Scrolls through the inbox. Clicks on new messages. Types replies on the keyboard. Opens the calendar application. Reads the day's community program schedule. Picks up the phone. Checks messages on the phone. Places the phone on the desk. Picks up the mug. Sips the tea. Adjusts the desk lamp angle. Turns on the router.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program coordination, answering calls and holding video meetings with partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sits down at the desk. Opens the video meeting application on the computer. Puts on the headset. Clicks the join button. Speaks into the microphone to introduce the agenda. Types notes on the keyboard. Picks up the phone when it rings. Answers the call. Speaks with a partner organization contact. Hangs up the call. Places the phone on the desk. Opens the participant records file. Scrolls through the spreadsheet. Types updates into the cells. Clicks to open a document. Reads the document on the screen. Stands up. Walks to the kitchen. Refills the mug with water. Walks back to the living room. Sits down again. Joins the second video meeting. Nods while listening. Types additional notes. Clicks the leave button. Removes the headset.

Stands up from the desk. Walks to the kitchen. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out lettuce, tomatoes and cheese. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Picks up a knife. Cuts the tomatoes on the cutting board. Cuts the lettuce. Picks up a plate. Places the lettuce and tomatoes on the plate. Picks up the cheese. Cuts slices of cheese. Places the cheese on the plate. Picks up a fork and a glass. Fills the glass with water from the tap. Turns off the tap. Carries the plate and glass to the table.

Sits down at the table. Picks up the fork. Eats the salad. Picks up the glass. Drinks the water. Sets the glass down. Continues eating with the fork. Finishes the salad. Stands up. Picks up the plate, fork and glass. Carries them to the sink. Rinses the plate under the tap. Opens the dishwasher door. Places the plate, fork and glass inside. Closes the dishwasher door. Wipes the table with the cloth. Turns off the tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work: planning upcoming community events, updating participant records and drafting grant notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks back to the living room. Sits down at the desk. Wakes the computer screen. Opens the event planning document. Types event dates and locations into the table. Picks up the phone. Calls a venue contact. Speaks about the booking. Hangs up. Places the phone on the desk. Opens the participant database. Types new participant entries. Corrects existing records. Opens a grant notes document. Types paragraphs on the keyboard. Picks up the mug. Drinks water. Sets the mug down. Stands up. Stretches both arms. Walks to the bathroom. Returns. Sits down again. Continues typing. Checks the schedule on the screen. Saves the documents. Closes the laptop lid halfway. Adjusts the desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming and tidying the living room after the working day
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from the desk. Walks to the corner. Picks up the vacuum cleaner. Presses the power button. Pushes the vacuum cleaner across the floor. Moves the vacuum under the desk. Pulls it back. Presses the power button to stop. Places the vacuum cleaner back in the corner. Picks up the mug and carries it to the kitchen. Picks up the cushion from the sofa. Places the cushion straight on the sofa. Picks up loose papers from the desk. Stacks the papers into a pile. Places the papers in a drawer. Closes the drawer.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into comfortable clothes and resting
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to Bedroom 1. Opens the wardrobe. Takes out a t-shirt and sweatpants. Places them on the bed. Unbuttons the shirt. Takes off the shirt. Takes off the trousers. Puts on the t-shirt. Puts on the sweatpants. Folds the shirt and trousers. Places them on the chair. Turns on the fan. Lies down on the bed. Closes eyes. Remains still on the bed for about twenty minutes.

Gets up from the bed. Walks to the kitchen. Turns on the kitchen light. Opens the refrigerator door. Takes out chicken, vegetables and sauce. Closes the refrigerator door. Places the items on the counter. Picks up the knife. Cuts the chicken on the cutting board. Cuts the vegetables. Picks up the frying pan. Places the pan on the induction cooker. Presses the power button. Pours oil into the pan. Adds the chicken. Picks up the spatula. Stirs the chicken. Adds the vegetables. Pours the sauce into the pan. Stirs the mixture. Presses the power button to turn off the induction cooker. Picks up a plate. Slides the food onto the plate. Turns on the range hood. Turns off the range hood.

Carries the plate to the table. Sits down at the table. Picks up the fork. Eats the chicken and vegetables. Picks up the glass. Drinks water. Sets the glass down. Continues eating with the fork. Finishes the meal. Stands up. Picks up the plate, fork and glass. Carries them to the sink. Opens the dishwasher door. Places the dishes inside. Closes the dishwasher door. Wipes the table with the cloth. Turns off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing: watching TV and playing a game on the console
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the living room. Sits down on the sofa. Picks up the remote control. Presses the power button. Turns on the TV. Changes channels with the remote. Sets the remote down on the sofa. Picks up the console controller. Presses the power button on the game console. Navigates the game menu with the controller. Presses buttons on the controller during gameplay. Leans forward on the sofa. Pauses the game. Picks up the remote control. Turns up the volume. Sets the remote down. Resumes the game. Plays for a while. Pauses the game again. Picks up the phone from the desk. Scrolls on the phone screen. Places the phone down. Continues playing. Saves the game. Presses the power button on the console. Presses the power button on the TV with the remote. Sets the remote down on the sofa. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to the bathroom. Turns on the bathroom light. Turns on the water heater. Opens the shower door. Turns on the shower tap. Steps into the shower. Washes the body with soap. Rinses the body under the water. Turns off the shower tap. Steps out of the shower. Picks up the towel. Dries the body. Wraps the towel around the body. Wipes the mirror with a cloth. Turns off the water heater. Picks up the toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off the tap. Turns off the bathroom light. Walks out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading on the phone and setting an alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to Bedroom 1. Puts on the pajamas. Turns on the fan. Lies down on the bed. Picks up the phone. Opens the reading application. Scrolls through articles. Reads for about twenty minutes. Opens the alarm application. Sets the alarm for 06:30. Places the phone on the nightstand. Pulls the blanket over the body. Turns to the side.
Closes eyes. Remains still on the bed. Keeps the fan running. Turns to the other side. Remains asleep through the night.
